description: Vary field name lowercase ('vary: Accept' on the wire) — normal Accept separation.
notes: Origin emits the Vary field name lowercase; HTTP field names are case-insensitive (RFC 9110 §5.1), so the run must PASS exactly like C01. The runner lowercases header names in evidence, so the wire-level lowercase fact is pinned separately by tests/golden/test_extended.py::test_e01_vary_field_name_is_lowercase_on_the_wire.
